# Full Model trained on all data
This is the model that was trained for multiclass classification.
- Tokenizes into 1-grams (words)
- Calculates tf-idf, but uses only the top 10000 most frequent tokens that were in under 90% of documents, but at least 3 documents
- Neural network has 2 hidden layers with 30 neurons each. Minimal l2 (ridge) regularization. Uses ReLU activation function
- Optimized with adam, loss function was sparse categorical cross entropy
- Added class weights to adjust loss function to adapt to class imbalances in data
```{r}
set_random_seed(1)

training_data <- claims_clean
class_levels <- levels(training_data$mclass)
n_classes <- length(class_levels)

training_tokens <- training_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
training_tf <- training_tokens %>% tf_fn()
idf <- training_tf %>% idf_fn(max_terms = 10000, max_doc_prop = 0.9, min_doc_freq = 3)
training_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(training_tf, idf, all_ids = training_data)

training_model_data <- training_tfidf %>%
  left_join(training_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")

x_train <- training_model_data %>%
  select(-.id, -mclass) %>%
  as.matrix()

y_train <- as.integer(factor(training_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)) - 1

# Weights
class_counts <- table(factor(training_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels))
class_proportions <- class_counts / sum(class_counts)
class_weights <- 1 / class_proportions^0.75
class_weights <- class_weights / mean(class_weights)
names(class_weights) <- as.character(0:(n_classes - 1))
class_weights <- as.list(class_weights)

model <- keras_model_sequential(input_shape = ncol(x_train)) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>%
  layer_dense(units = n_classes) %>%
  layer_activation(activation = "softmax")

model %>% compile(loss = "sparse_categorical_crossentropy", optimizer = "adam",
  metrics = "accuracy"
)

model_training_history <- fit(model, x = x_train, y = y_train, epochs = 20, batch_size = 32, class_weight = class_weights)
```

```{r}
save_model_tf(model, "results/multiclass_model", overwrite = T)
save(idf, class_levels, file = "data/multiclass_idf_levels.rda")
```

# Initial Proof of Concept for Multiclass Neural Net
```{r}
set_random_seed(1)
# Data Split
data_split <- initial_split(claims_clean, prop = 0.8, strata = mclass)
training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data <- testing(data_split)
folds <- vfold_cv(training_data, 5, strata = mclass)

cv_results <- vector("list", 5)
class_levels <- levels(training_data$mclass)
n_classes <- length(class_levels)

for(fold in 1:5){
  message(paste0("Fold ", fold))
  analysis_data <- analysis(folds$splits[[fold]])
  assessment_data <- assessment(folds$splits[[fold]])
  
  # Tokenize and calculate term frequency
  # Can change the length of an n-gram here
  analysis_tokens <- analysis_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
  assessment_tokens <- assessment_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
  analysis_tf <- analysis_tokens %>% tf_fn()
  assessment_tf <- assessment_tokens %>% tf_fn()
  
  # IDF from analysis
  # Can change the # of ngram terms and selection criteria
  idf <- analysis_tf %>% idf_fn(max_terms = 10000, max_doc_prop = 0.9, min_doc_freq = 2)
  
  # tfidf matrices
  analysis_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(analysis_tf, idf, all_ids = analysis_data)
  assessment_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(assessment_tf, idf, all_ids = assessment_data)
  
  # Consolidate data for neural network
  analysis_model_data <- analysis_tfidf %>% left_join(analysis_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")
  assessment_model_data <- assessment_tfidf %>% left_join(assessment_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")
  
  x_train <- analysis_model_data %>% select(-.id, -mclass) %>% as.matrix()
  y_train <- as.integer(factor(analysis_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)) - 1
  
  x_assess <- assessment_model_data %>% select(-.id, -mclass) %>% as.matrix()
  y_assess <- factor(assessment_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)
  
  # Neural Network Training
  # Model Specification
  model <- keras_model_sequential(input_shape = ncol(x_train)) %>% 
    layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>% 
    layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>% 
    layer_dense(units = n_classes) %>% 
    layer_activation(activation = "softmax")
  
  # Model Configuration
  model %>% compile(loss = "sparse_categorical_crossentropy", optimizer = "adam", metrics = "accuracy")
  
  # Can change the number of epochs
  training <- fit(model, x = x_train, y = y_train, epochs = 20)

  # Generate predictions
  predictions <- predict(model, x_assess)
  predicted_class <- factor(class_levels[max.col(predictions)], levels = class_levels)
  probabilities <- as_tibble(predictions)
  names(probabilities) <- class_levels
  
  # Metrics 
  fold_predictions <- tibble(truth = y_assess, predicted = predicted_class) %>% bind_cols(probabilities)
  fold_metrics <- fold_predictions %>% summarize(accuracy = accuracy_vec(truth, predicted), macro_f1 = f_meas_vec(truth, predicted, estimator = "macro"))

  # Store fold results
  cv_results[[fold]] <- list(metrics = fold_metrics, predictions = fold_predictions)
}

# Combine fold metrics
cv_metrics <- bind_rows(lapply(cv_results, function(x) x$metrics), .id = "fold")
cv_predictions <- bind_rows(lapply(cv_results, function(x) x$predictions), .id = "fold")

# Calculate mean 
cv_summary <- cv_metrics %>%
  summarize(across(c(accuracy, macro_f1), mean))

cv_summary
conf_mat(cv_predictions, truth = truth, estimate = predicted)
```
Current config: 10000 terms, 20 epochs, 2 hidden layer w/ 30 neurons
80.2% accuracy, 71.2% macro F1

# Tuning the Multiclass Neural Net
```{r}
set_random_seed(1)
# Data Split
data_split <- initial_split(claims_clean, prop = 0.8, strata = mclass)
training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data <- testing(data_split)
folds <- vfold_cv(training_data, 5, strata = mclass)

cv_results <- vector("list", 5)
class_levels <- levels(training_data$mclass)
n_classes <- length(class_levels)

for(fold in 1:5){
  message(paste0("Fold ", fold))
  analysis_data <- analysis(folds$splits[[fold]])
  assessment_data <- assessment(folds$splits[[fold]])
  
  # Tokenize and calculate term frequency
  # Can change the length of an n-gram here
  analysis_tokens <- analysis_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
  assessment_tokens <- assessment_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
  analysis_tf <- analysis_tokens %>% tf_fn()
  assessment_tf <- assessment_tokens %>% tf_fn()
  
  # IDF from analysis
  # Can change the # of ngram terms and selection criteria
  idf <- analysis_tf %>% idf_fn(max_terms = 10000, max_doc_prop = 0.9, min_doc_freq = 2)
  
  # tfidf matrices
  analysis_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(analysis_tf, idf, all_ids = analysis_data)
  assessment_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(assessment_tf, idf, all_ids = assessment_data)
  
  # Consolidate data for neural network
  analysis_model_data <- analysis_tfidf %>% left_join(analysis_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")
  assessment_model_data <- assessment_tfidf %>% left_join(assessment_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")
  
  x_train <- analysis_model_data %>% select(-.id, -mclass) %>% as.matrix()
  y_train <- as.integer(factor(analysis_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)) - 1
  
  x_assess <- assessment_model_data %>% select(-.id, -mclass) %>% as.matrix()
  y_assess <- factor(assessment_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)
  
  # Neural Network Training
  # Model Specification
  model <- keras_model_sequential(input_shape = ncol(x_train)) %>% 
    layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>% 
    layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>% 
    layer_dense(units = n_classes) %>% 
    layer_activation(activation = "softmax")
  
  # Model Configuration
  model %>% compile(loss = "sparse_categorical_crossentropy", optimizer = "adam", metrics = "accuracy")
  
  # TESTING CLASS WEIGHTING 
  class_counts <- table(factor(analysis_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels))
  class_proportions <- class_counts / sum(class_counts)
  
  # Weighting with normalization
  class_weights <- 1 / class_proportions^0.75
  class_weights <- class_weights / mean(class_weights)
  
  # Match weights to integer-encoded class labels
  names(class_weights) <- as.character(0:(n_classes - 1))
  class_weights <- as.list(class_weights)
  training <- fit(model, x = x_train, y = y_train, epochs = 20, class_weight = class_weights)

  # Generate predictions
  predictions <- predict(model, x_assess)
  predicted_class <- factor(class_levels[max.col(predictions)], levels = class_levels)
  probabilities <- as_tibble(predictions)
  names(probabilities) <- class_levels
  
  # Metrics 
  fold_predictions <- tibble(truth = y_assess, predicted = predicted_class) %>% bind_cols(probabilities)
  fold_metrics <- fold_predictions %>% summarize(accuracy = accuracy_vec(truth, predicted), macro_f1 = f_meas_vec(truth, predicted, estimator = "macro"))

  # Store fold results
  cv_results[[fold]] <- list(metrics = fold_metrics, predictions = fold_predictions)
}

# Combine fold metrics
cv_metrics <- bind_rows(lapply(cv_results, function(x) x$metrics), .id = "fold")
cv_predictions <- bind_rows(lapply(cv_results, function(x) x$predictions), .id = "fold")

# Calculate mean 
cv_summary <- cv_metrics %>%
  summarize(across(c(accuracy, macro_f1), mean))

cv_summary
conf_mat(cv_predictions, truth = truth, estimate = predicted)
```

# Model on Testing Data
```{r}
set_random_seed(1)

# Data Split
data_split <- initial_split(claims_clean, prop = 0.8, strata = mclass)
training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data <- testing(data_split)

# Establish class levels
class_levels <- levels(training_data$mclass)
n_classes <- length(class_levels)

# Tokenize and calculate term frequency
training_tokens <- training_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
training_tf <- training_tokens %>% tf_fn()

# IDF calculated exclusively from training data
idf <- training_tf %>% idf_fn(max_terms = 10000, max_doc_prop = 0.9, min_doc_freq = 2)

# Generate training TF-IDF matrix
training_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(training_tf, idf, all_ids = training_data)

# Consolidate training data
training_model_data <- training_tfidf %>% left_join(training_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")

x_train <- training_model_data %>% select(-.id, -mclass) %>% as.matrix()
y_train <- as.integer(factor(training_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)) - 1

# Weights
class_counts <- table(factor(training_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels))
class_proportions <- class_counts / sum(class_counts)

# Weighting with normalization
class_weights <- 1 / class_proportions^0.75
class_weights <- class_weights / mean(class_weights)

# Match weights to integer-encoded class labels
names(class_weights) <- as.character(0:(n_classes - 1))
class_weights <- as.list(class_weights)

# Model specification
model <- keras_model_sequential(input_shape = ncol(x_train)) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 30, activation = "relu", kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)) %>%
  layer_dense(units = n_classes) %>%
  layer_activation(activation = "softmax")

# Model configuration
model %>% compile(loss = "sparse_categorical_crossentropy", optimizer = "adam", metrics = "accuracy")

# Train model
model_training_history <- fit(model, x = x_train, y = y_train, epochs = 20, class_weight = class_weights)

# Testing Data
testing_tokens <- testing_data %>% tokenize_fn(n = 1)
testing_tf <- testing_tokens %>% tf_fn()
testing_tfidf <- tfidf_fn_updated(testing_tf, idf, all_ids = testing_data)

# Consolidate testing data
testing_model_data <- testing_tfidf %>%
  left_join(testing_data %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id")

x_test <- testing_model_data %>%
  select(-.id, -mclass) %>%
  as.matrix()

y_test <- factor(testing_model_data$mclass, levels = class_levels)

# Predictions
predictions <- predict(model, x_test)
predicted_class <- factor(class_levels[max.col(predictions)], levels = class_levels)
probabilities <- as_tibble(predictions)
names(probabilities) <- class_levels

# Model Metrics
test_predictions <- tibble(truth = y_test, predicted = predicted_class) %>%
  bind_cols(probabilities)

# Calculate metrics
test_metrics <- test_predictions %>%
  summarize(accuracy = accuracy_vec(truth, predicted), macro_f1 = f_meas_vec(truth, predicted, estimator = "macro"))
confusion_matrix <- conf_mat(test_predictions, truth = truth, estimate = predicted)

test_metrics
confusion_matrix
```
